entry.title: The languages in your family’s day
entry.summary: Davies describes different ways a multilingual family can make its languages part of everyday life: through particular people, or through familiar places and times.
entry.cue: Your household or caregivers may use more than one language.
detail: One example has adults speaking their own mother tongues with the child and an agreed language together. Another uses different languages in different settings. These are alternatives families can consider, not a demand to use both.
The useful focus is the language children share with real people in daily life. The book’s family anecdote illustrates an arrangement; it does not establish a fluency timetable.
